ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to PHOCS Regulatory Code Violation records when PHOCSParentId__c is populated, unless the user has the EHIS Bypass Validation Rule custom permission. Users may only update the Status field to Resolved.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRegulatoryCodeViolation", NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), NOT(ISBLANK(PHOCSParentId__c)), NOT(AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This record cannot be edited because it is linked to a parent violation record.
